label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
Tolu, I'm inside it right now, so let me answer you. I'm in Biology 100L at a federal uni here in Lagos, and I wanted Medicine. I scored 251 in JAMB 2025, applied for Medicine and Surgery, and they offered me Biology. This your post is literally me last year.

Let me start with the crying, because nobody has addressed it. The day I saw Biology on the portal I locked myself in my cousin's room in Surulere and cried. I didn't eat that day. My mum was still telling people in church that I'm doing medicine for like two months after, and I had to beg her to stop. So you're not overreacting. It pains, and it's allowed to pain you.

Now the transfer. I'll tell you exactly what our level adviser told us, because that is the only thing I know for sure. To move from our faculty to MBBS after 100L, you need a CGPA of at least 4.5 out of 5, AND there must be space in Medicine. If you get the 4.5 and there's no space, you're not going anywhere.

She also said you must have met the Medicine cut-off in both JAMB and post-UTME. So please check those two things for your own school: what their Medicine cut-offs were, and what you actually scored in post-UTME. I don't know either of them, and 268 on its own doesn't tell anybody whether you qualify.

Then the numbers. She said last year about 6 people were moved into Medicine from the whole faculty, and she thinks more than 40 applied. That's the whole faculty o, not Biology alone.

So @Kingsley_MLS, with respect, transfer is not a myth. People moved last year. But @favour.o, "just read hard" is too simple. Plenty of those 40-plus people read hard too. You can do everything right and still not be among the ones that get in.

My own CGPA after first semester is 4.31, not 4.5. I'm still trying and I haven't given up, but I'm telling you so you can see that somebody who is serious and reading can still be below the line. Transfer is real but it is NOT easy, and nobody should accept Biology thinking it is automatic. If you accept, accept it knowing you may finish in Biology, and ask yourself if you can live with that.

How is 100L itself? The courses are BIO 101, CHM 101, PHY 101, MTH 101 and GST. Biology and Chemistry are okay if you were a science student. Physics and Maths are the ones dealing with people, and they're the ones dragging CGPAs down, mine included. If you come in chasing 4.5, those two are where the fight is.

There is small money involved too, so tell your dad ahead:
- Lab coat: ₦6,500
- Dissecting kit: ₦9,000
- Practical manual: extra on top

Is Biology a bad course? No, and I'm not saying it to console you. In our first BIO practical we dissected toads, and one guy in my group fainted. I was fine. I was even enjoying it, and that was the day I realised I actually like this thing. I'm enjoying genetics and cell biology more than I expected. I think a lot of what we feel is that we had our mind on Medicine, so anything else looked like failure. Biology is a real course, it's just not the one we planned for.

About rewriting, I won't tell you it's wrong, because it's not. If you're ready for it, it's a valid choice. But let me tell you the side nobody mentions when they say "one year is nothing". My secondary school classmate Ifeoma got Pharmacy, rejected it to rewrite for Medicine, and has written JAMB two more times since then. She's still at home. I'm not saying that will be you. Some people rewrite once and get it. But staying at home is not as easy as people make it sound, and the next JAMB is not guaranteed either. Both roads have risk. You're choosing which risk you can carry.

One thing I wish somebody had asked me that week: do you want Medicine itself, or do you want to be "doctor" for your parents? Think about it alone, without your dad and your aunty in the room. If it's Medicine itself and you can't see yourself in anything else, that leans one way. If it's more the title and what people in church will say (I've been there, see my mum above), then Biology may not be the tragedy it looks like today.

Before that acceptance fee deadline, please go to the faculty or the department in your school and ask them the exact transfer rules:
1. What CGPA do they require?
2. How many people did they take last year, and how many applied?
3. Do they look at your JAMB and post-UTME scores?
4. Is transfer to Medicine even allowed from Biology in your school?

Everything I've told you is from my own school and my own adviser. Your school may be different. Don't just trust forum people for this, and that includes me.

Whatever you choose, it's not the end of the world. I thought it was, that day in Surulere, and here I am arguing about toads and genetics. If you accept, you can still fight for transfer with your eyes open. If you rewrite, you're not a failure for trying again. Just make the decision with correct information from your school and not from panic.

You can message me if you want to ask anything else about 100L. I'll answer what I know.

reasons: It does not explicitly tell Tolu to verify both entrance cutoffs directly with her faculty or department.
